name: Table
description: Tabular rows with per-column formatting, conditional emphasis, client-side sort and row or cell activation.

generation.purpose: Show a list of records with several attributes each, so the user can scan, sort and open individual rows.
generation.whenToUse: For record-level detail — exception queues, file loads, search results. Bind one column per attribute the user needs, and put the entity key in a hidden column so a drill-down action can read it.
generation.whenNotToUse: Do not use for aggregated figures or for a breakdown by a dimension; use analytics.kpi-card for a single value and analytics.chart for a dimensioned series.

maxHeight.description: Scroll the table body beyond this height, keeping the header visible.

rowActivated.label: Row activated
rowActivated.description: Emitted when a row is clicked or activated with Enter. Payload is the row.

selectionChanged.label: Selection changed
selectionChanged.description: Emitted when selectionMode is 'single' and the selected row changes.

cellActivated.label: Cell activated
cellActivated.description: Emitted when a link cell is activated. Supersedes rowActivated so a link does not also drill the row.

retryRequested.label: Retry requested
retryRequested.description: Emitted when the user activates Retry in the error state.

xs.note: Body scrolls horizontally inside its own container; the page never scrolls sideways.

accessibility.keyboardContract: Column headers are buttons that toggle sort and report aria-sort. Rows are focusable and Enter-activatable only when interactive. Link cells are buttons and stop propagation so keyboard users get one unambiguous target per cell.
accessibility.notes: A caption names the table and states the row count for screen readers. Conditional emphasis is accompanied by the value text, never colour alone.

lifecycle.migrationNote: M1 sorts client-side over the returned page and is not virtualized. Server-side sort and virtualization land with the real Data Gateway.
